description: Create a journal entry with postings

block_on_duplicate.description: Refuse creation when a bank posting looks like an already-booked duplicate (default false: warn only).

document_number.description: Document number. Recommended for imported or mechanism-crossing entries: a stable source reference (e.g. WISE:{id}, LY:{ref}, BANK:{stmt-ref}) — used for duplicate detection.

postings.description: Postings [{accounts_id, type: 'D'|'C', amount, accounts_dimensions_id?, base_amount?, projects_project_id?, projects_location_id?, projects_person_id?}]. accounts_dimensions_id is REQUIRED when accounts_id has sub-accounts. base_amount = EUR equivalent for non-EUR entries. projects_* fields link the posting to project tracking dimensions.

title.description: Journal entry title (max 100 characters — the API rejects longer titles)

name: create_journal
title: Create Journal
